notes.text: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
Student must complete a minimum of 120 units of academic work and a minimum of 32 units of Cooperative Education in order to earn the Bachelor of Science degree in civil engineering.
General Education Requirements

For more details, see General Education
Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.
CORE Requirements

Notes:
1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 
2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.
Breadth Requirement (7 courses, at least 3 units each)
Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.
Diversity and Inclusion Requirement

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)
Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.
Fundamental Skills

Students must demonstrate competence in:
Writing
Quantitative Analysis (Math)
Note:  Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.
Major Requirements

Notes:
In addition to the following courses, students are required to take:
1) One 3 or 4 unit 100-Level BENG, CIVL, ECPE, EMGT, ENGR, or MECH.
2) AP CHEM scores of 4 or 5, or IB CHEM Higher Level scores of 5, 6, or 7, will satisfy the elective.
3) A minimum of one structural design elective (3 units minimum) and one infrastructure systems elective (3 units minimum).
4) 3-4 units of Math/Science Elective.
5) 3-4 units of Geological/Biological Science Elective.
6) One 3 or 4 unit 100-Level BENG, CIVL, ECPE, EMGT, ENGR, or MECH.
